task.ques: Find a course on Coursera that teaches Reinforcement Learning for Intermediate with a rating of at least 4.5. Provide the name of the course, the institution offering it, and the number of reviews it has received.

claude.final_answer: FINAL: Fundamentals of Reinforcement Learning, offered by the University of Alberta and the Alberta Machine Intelligence Institute, is an Intermediate-level Coursera course rated 4.8/5 with 2,911 reviews. Verified October 27, 2026, on the course page: https://www.coursera.org/learn/fundamentals-of-reinforcement-learning . Evidence: final.png shows the course name, Intermediate level, rating, and review count together.
